title: Nested operations are atomic savepoints; outbox delivery runs after commit

options.text: Retain ambient joins and require every command to validate before all writes or manage its own savepoint.
options.cons: Validation cannot prevent codec, projection, database or plugin failures after a write; new packages can repeat the same defect.

options.text: Transactions::run protects each nested operation with a savepoint on the Commerz connection; retain the outer settings and commit boundary.
options.pros: One enforcement point for atomicity across packages and host transactions.
options.cons: An extra savepoint for nested calls; callers still decide whether to retry a whole transaction.

context: The owner requested a full audit and execution of repairs for P1–P2 and delegated architecture decisions. Regressions against f7c030f demonstrated a retained receipt claim and partial option relabels when the host caught a failed operation. PostgreSQL concurrency-error recovery also needs an explicit rollback to the savepoint; Laravel’s nested deadlock branch only decrements transaction metadata.
decision: B. Nested Transactions::run begins a savepoint, commits its transaction metadata on success, explicitly rolls back to the prior level on every error, and rethrows it. The outer transaction retains lock_timeout and final commit; no automatic retry. OutboxRelay refuses an open transaction before claiming rows or invoking consumers.
rationale: Strengthens INV-01 and EXT-01 at their owning core boundary without per-package copies or a new abstraction. PostgreSQL savepoints also recover the transaction from 40P01/40001 errors. Explicit owner authorization supersedes the audit command’s original read-only product scope.
consequences: Nested transactionLevel now increases inside the callback; record this behavioral contract change before the first 0.1 release.
CommittedEvents remains tied to the outer commit and drops rolled-back savepoint events; ordering across nested levels is not promised.
Use a committed-data test for relay delivery; RefreshDatabase wraps a transaction and cannot represent production delivery.
No released migration or exported method signature changes.
